import json, os, pathlib, subprocess, time
os.umask(0o077)
base=pathlib.Path('/home/jder/.local/state/codex-async-followup/credentials')
state=base/'early-fine-torch-relayed.json'
completed=set(json.loads(state.read_text())) if state.exists() else set()
jobs=['19410261','19410263','19410264']
remote="import json,pathlib; p=pathlib.Path('/scratch/jr7309/runs/2026-10-08-early-fine-rtx/.followup'); print(json.dumps({j:json.loads((p/('torch-'+j+'.json.event.json')).read_text()) for j in ['19410261','19410263','19410264'] if (p/('torch-'+j+'.json.event.json')).exists()}))"
while len(completed)<len(jobs):
    try:
        subprocess.run(['ssh','-O','check','torch'],check=True,capture_output=True,timeout=15)
        result=subprocess.run(['ssh','-o','ConnectTimeout=20','torch','python3 -'],input=remote,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True,timeout=60)
        events=json.loads(result.stdout)
        for job,payload in events.items():
            if job in completed or job not in jobs:continue
            credential=base/('torch-'+job+'.json')
            event=credential.with_suffix('.json.event.json')
            if event.exists():
                if json.loads(event.read_text())!=payload:raise RuntimeError('Conflicting saved event')
            else:
                with event.open('x') as f:json.dump(payload,f)
            subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3','/home/jder/.codex/skills/async-job-followup/scripts/send.py','--credential-file',str(credential)],check=True,timeout=360)
            completed.add(job)
            state.write_text(json.dumps(sorted(completed)))
            print('Relayed terminal event for '+job,flush=True)
    except Exception as exc:
        print('Relay check deferred: '+type(exc).__name__,flush=True)
    if len(completed)<len(jobs):time.sleep(600)
